_THE_FINDING.so: a call that provably never ran was reported by unknownOutcomes() as OUTCOME_UNKNOWN, i.e. as an effect whose outcome is unresolved.
_THE_FINDING.cause: unknownOutcomes() filtered on `settledAt === undefined` alone; the only writer of settledAt is runOne (bridge.ts:809), reached only when entry.started === true (bridge.ts:772). An abandoned call therefore never gets the stamp.
